reason: Value and transfer lens: the realistic public gain is about +0.0003 (range 0 to +0.001), well below the +0.002 bar and below the 0.003 LB noise. (1) Ceiling. Each FN->TP is worth 1/W = 1/135,729 = 7.37e-6 in the lab (micro-average, tools/official/metrics.md). The only pool that readmit or gapfill can reach is the 424 detection-side FN whose matched end is a free track end or start (fn_anatomy_exp39.md), so the ceiling is +0.0031. Those 424 FN include a_tail, a_linefit and a_taken, where the primary node existed. A copy peak placed more than 2 um from the primary peaks cannot help those, and a_never is only 65% of a_* (1,907/2,929). The +0.014 'all a_never' number cannot be reached through readmit, which adds one node next to an open end in a single round. (2) The mechanism rests on 9% of the loss. The under-segmentation evidence (r2_critic.notes.md l.15-16: Ultrack point 2.3 um, our node 1.9 um from another object, +44% Ultrack points) was measured on 25 44b6 clips only. 44b6 has 167 of the 1,907 a_never FN (ceiling +0.0012). The 1,740 in 6bba (91%) have no measured mechanism, and dense Ultrack labels do not exist for 6bba. 'Densest 6bba quartile = 52% of loss' refers to the whole loss, which is mostly b_swap/b_* localisation, not a_never. (3) x138 already works this pool. Readmit adds 1.1% nodes (1,337/121,777 on the dummy test, CONTEXT.md l.1515) from ILP-discarded primary peaks >= 0.965, and gapfill already uses primary peaks >= 0.5 (DIFF.md l.108-112). The exp39 anatomy has neither stage, so the residual on x138 is smaller than 424. (4) Chain of factors, each a guess: 424 x x138-residual 0.6-0.9 x a_never share 0.5-0.8 x 4 um readmit geometry 0.5-0.8 (the end node sits up to 7 um from its GT, and the GT step is 1.8 um) x copy recall at >= 0.9 of 0.25-0.5 (the idea's own gate is >= 25%) x 1.0-1.2 FN per node x 0.9 adj multiplier. That gives +0.0001 / +0.0004 / +0.0010 lab (low/central/generous). (5) Costs. Node term 0.1*dN/N: 0.3% added nodes = -0.00027. FP risk: per metrics.md, a wrong copy node attached to an ANNOTATED end whose GT has another successor is an FP, not free. Copy nodes can also steal the 7 um optimal assignment from loose primary matches in the dense swap zone. Net central is about +0.0002..+0.0004. (6) Transfer does not rescue it. Public adjusted-edge is about 0.91 (0.947 - 0.036 division), against lab adjusted-edge about 0.90 (0.9143 - 0.1*23/194). So the unseen public embryo does not show a much larger detection-FN share than the in-sample lab, and there is no 'unseen embryos miss more' multiplier. The copy is a 1,200-iteration, lr 5e-5 fine-tune from the SAME pilkwang init, so its misses on unseen embryos are highly correlated with the primary's. What it adds is Ultrack's centroid and over-segmentation convention from ONE recording (all 44b6 clips are overlapping crops of the dorado movie; 0.43 um z offset; 16% of 44b6 GT are > 2.5 um from Ultrack; 23% of Ultrack points have no prediction within 7 um, many possibly spurious). Its 0.9 readmit threshold is calibrated on 44b6 and trusts network confidence, the failure mode the brief's lab caveat names. Private: dense private embryos might gain slightly more, but the same bound holds (< +0.001 central). Even a perfect result could not be told apart from noise on one public probe.
fix_if_any: Not as a standalone probe. The only repair that could lift it above +0.002 is to widen the reachable pool beyond single-node readmit: run the copy's peaks through the full graph as ILP candidates, which brings back the closed frozen-linker risk, or pair them with a tracklet gap-closing LAP (v3 h_linking-on-x138 'tracklet-gap-lap') so that whole missing segments can be filled. Even then it must first pass a CPU x138-tail lab on 6bba held-out videos with: (a) an a_never-recovered count >= 250 FN net of new FP, i.e. >= +0.0018 lab; (b) >= 7/12 videos non-negative; and (c) the node increase <= 0.5%. Without that lab, do not spend an LB slot. Cheaper check first (CPU, no training): on friend A's lab cache, count how many of the 424 free-end detection-side FN have their missing GT node within 4 um of the free end AND lie outside every x138 primary low-det peak >= 0.5 within 2 um. If that count is < 200, the idea is dead regardless of detector quality.
realistic_public_gain: +0.0003 central (range -0.0005..+0.001). The idea's own central estimate is +0.001, which is below the +0.002 bar and the 0.003 LB noise.
realistic_private_gain: +0.0003..+0.001 (guess); denser private embryos could help slightly, but the copy's 44b6-calibrated scores and Ultrack convention transfer uncertainly, so the sign is not guaranteed.
critical_path: Friend A (5070 Ti, availability uncertain) builds the dense 44b6 labels from the dorado registration, fine-tunes the copy (~1 h) and runs the gate on 12 6bba videos: 26 Sep 08:00-20:00 UTC. Then the final retrain and weights upload (1.5 h). The agent writes --patch denseprop and its tests (4 h, can run in parallel). Kaggle vitalii dummy run (1.2 GPU-h) on 27 Sep ~01:00, submit ~02:00, scored ~09:00-12:00 27 Sep. The schedule fits in principle, but it depends entirely on friend A and competes with his division line. Even if scored, a +0.0003..+0.001 effect cannot be read against 0.003 LB noise, so the probe carries no decision value.
